policy.leg_force_trace_scope: per-leg arrays follow leg_body_names in robot body order, matched to sensor names; current policy-boundary normal-force norm and retained-history peak norm; sparse traces do not measure contact duration

leg_current_normal_force_w_n.measurement: net normal contact force XYZ vector [N]; tangential friction excluded

leg_trace_telemetry.scope: trace-only at the existing pre-reset capture; null field means unavailable; no metric or validity-mask input

heading_control.inputs: root yaw only; standard velocity-command channels

policy.metrics_scope: first episode until completion/fall/stall/escape/timeout; physics captured before auto-reset; smoothness excludes first second

contact_sampling.history_count_window_definition: history_length times sample interval; distinct from oldest sample age
contact_sampling.cadence_evidence: inferred from instantiated config and scene stepping; runtime sensor timestamps were not measured
contact_sampling.history_limit: history peaks can miss contacts outside the retained samples; reset rows start with zero history
contact_sampling.current_sample_scope: latest sensor force at the policy boundary before auto-reset; no substep duration inference
contact_sampling.force_measure: world-frame vector norm of net normal force, including riser normals; no tangential friction force
contact_sampling.slip_velocity_measure: foot-link world-horizontal speed at the policy boundary; not contact-point tangential slip
contact_sampling.legacy_results: reports without this metadata keep their original sampling semantics and cannot be assumed to use physics-step history

policy.slip_metric_scope: foot-link horizontal speed gated by retained normal-contact history peaks >1N; cadence is in contact_sampling; proxy, not contact-point tangential slip
policy.current_sample_slip_metric_scope: foot-link horizontal speed gated only by latest normal-contact force >1N at the same policy boundary; proxy, not contact-point tangential slip
policy.smoothness_note: Metrics are reported for comparison; no universal smoothness threshold has been calibrated
policy.seed_scope: reset RNG seeds; startup terrain/material/dynamics are sampled once at environment construction and fixed across reset seeds; enabled reset-mode dynamics events (such as actuator gains) resample on resets
